value.signature: fn emit < T : serde :: Serialize > (value : & T) -> io :: Result < () >

review.body: { let scope = crate :: observation :: scope ("CLICOMMON" , "rule:observe:spans" , "emit" , & std :: any :: type_name :: < T > ()) ; let result = { let mut bytes = serde_json :: to_vec (value) ? ; bytes . push (b'\n') ; let stdout = io :: stdout () ; let mut out = stdout . lock () ; out . write_all (& bytes) ? ; out . flush () } ; scope . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: Current body serializes a complete public JSON result before one stdout write attempt and reports transport failure without promising physical rollback.
